Case when there is no facility data in the system:

Step 1: When there is no facility data in the system, the “List of available facility” template will be empty. For every facility added the user needs to input the Facility Name (must be unique), Facility Type (Warehouse/Health Facility), Facility Status (Temporary/Permanent), Capacity (Number input)

Step 2: To map the facilities to a given boundary the user needs to copy the correct Boundary Code from the “Boundary Data” sheet. If there are more than one boundaries that a facility needs to be mapped to, the user can add all the boundary codes separated by commas

Step 3: For every facility, the user needs to add Active or Inactive for all facilities under the “Facility Usage” column. All the Facilities marked as “Active” will be used in the campaign being created the ones marked “Inactive” will not be used in the campaign being created.
Step 4: Once all the facilities are added the user needs to save the file on their system and upload the file by pressing “Browse in My Files” option.
Case when there is existing facility data in the system:

Step 1: When you open the downloaded facility template, please refer to the List of available Facility sheet. For existing facilities, kindly add entries in the Boundary Code column. You can find the boundary codes in the Boundary Data sheet. If a facility maps to multiple boundaries, please separate the codes with commas.

Step 2: In this step the user will have to add entries in the Facility Usage column with valid entries being either Active or Inactive where the user can set the usage for a facility to Active if the facility is being is used for a campaign or else can be set to Inactive. The inputs in the Facility Usage column need to be added for all entries.

Step 3: For adding new Facilities which are not present in the list of existing facilities, the user needs to input the Facility Name (must be unique), Facility Type (Warehouse/Health Facility), Facility Status (Temporary/Permanent), Capacity (Number input), Boundary Code(from the Boundary Data Sheet) and Facility Usage (Active/Inactive) as explained previously
Step 4: Once all the facilities are added the user needs to save the file on their system and upload the file by pressing “Browse in My Files” option.
If the user has removed Facility codes for an existing facility in the list then system will create a duplicate facility with those column values.

If the user deletes any of the headers in the sheet and uploads the sheet, the system will throw an error and the user will have to download the template again and reupload the correct sheet with the correct data.

Download the microplan template to add facility details, user assignments, and target data in one place. The sheet includes dropdowns for selecting boundaries, facility types, roles, and other required fields.

Fill in all mandatory fields, update targets for each boundary, and review entries for accuracy before uploading the completed file. Missing entries, deleted columns, or modified headers will result in upload errors. Once the sheet is complete, save it and upload it to load all microplan data for the campaign.
Facility Data: Creating New or Reusing Existing Facilities

Once the template is downloaded, the "Facilities List" tab will be pre-populated with any existing facility data available for reuse if none exists yet, the tab will be empty. To create a new facility, add the Facility Name, Facility Type, Facility Status, and Capacity, and leave the "Facility Code" column empty. For a facility that is being reused, no changes are needed beyond mapping it to the correct boundary (see below).

Map each facility to the correct boundary by copying the Boundary Code from the "List of Campaign Boundaries" sheet into that facility's row. If a facility is mapped to more than one boundary, add all the relevant Boundary Codes separated by commas in the same cell.

To exclude an existing facility from the campaign, delete that facility's entire row from the sheet before uploading only the facilities you want included should remain, each with the correct Boundary Code(s) mapped.
User Data: Creating Users for the Campaign
Create a separate row for each user. The following fields are mandatory for every user: Name, Phone Number, Role, Employment Type, and Boundary Code.
If a user is mapped to multiple roles, add all the relevant roles separated by commas in the Role cell for that user.

Assign each user to the correct boundary using the Boundary Code from the "List of Campaign Boundaries" sheet. If a user is mapped to multiple boundaries, add all the relevant Boundary Codes separated by commas in the same cell.
Once all user entries are complete, save the sheet and upload it using the "Browse In My Files" button on the upload screen.
Target Data: Setting Targets for Each Boundary
Go to the "Boundary List "sheet and enter a number in the "Target" column for every village or boundary listed.
Every listed village or boundary must have a target value entered under the "Target at the Selected Boundary Level" column if any are left blank, the sheet will have errors on upload.
Once targets are entered for all villages, save the sheet and upload it using the "Browse In My Files" button on the upload screen.
Common Errors and How to Avoid Them
If a mandatory field is missing such as a Boundary Code for a Facility/User, or a Target value for a village the system will throw an error listing the specific line number that needs to be fixed.

If any headers, columns, or sheets are deleted from the template before uploading, the system will throw an error. Download the template again and re-enter the correct data rather than continuing to edit the affected file.

If the Facility Code is removed for a facility that already exists (instead of only leaving it blank for genuinely new facilities), the system will create a duplicate facility rather than updating the existing one.
Guidelines for filling the user sheet
Please go through the 'User roles' sheet to read and understand the accessibility of each role.
Please fill the user details (Name, contact number and email) in each of the sheets belonging to the role accordingly.
Please don't assign the duplicate user in both Microplan estimation approver and National microplan estimation approver roles.
Please don't assign duplicate users in both Facility boundary assigner and National facility boundary assigner roles.
Please don't assign duplicate users in both Population data approver and National population data approver roles.
Downloading excel templates for creating users:
Download the excel template by clicking on the “Download Template” button.

Open the excel template that was downloaded in the previous step will have 3 sheets and the first sheet you will see is a “Read Me” sheet. The second Sheet named “Create List of Users“ that will be an empty sheet where the user needs to enter data to create users for the campaign. The third sheet will be named “List of Campaign Boundaries“ which will have all the boundaries selected in the “Boundary Details“ step with their respective boundary codes.

The System Admin will have to create a separate entry for each user. The System Admin will have to add The Name of the User (Mandatory), Phone Number (Mandatory),Role (Mandatory) Employment Type (Mandatory), Boundary Code (Mandatory). If there is a user who is mapped to multiple roles, the System Admin will have to add all the roles that user is mapped to by separating them by commas in the cell to add Roles for that user.

Each user being created needs to be assigned to a boundary using the Boundary Code of the required boundary which can be found in the “List of Campaign Boundaries“. If there is a user who is mapped to multiple boundaries, the System Admin will have to add the boundary codes of all the boundaries that user is mapped to by separating them by commas in the cell to add Boundary Codes for that user.
Save the sheet with the updated targets for each village on the excel template .
Press the “Browse In My Files” button on the “Upload Target” screen and select the saved file with all targets from the system.
If the user has not added boundary codes for all user entries, the system will throw an error with line number where the boundary code is missing

If the user deletes any of the headers in the sheet and uploads the sheet, the system will throw an error and the user will have to download the template again and reupload the correct sheet with the correct data.
